name: Assign Appt For Service Resource For Field Service
description: Assigns the service appointment selected by the dispatcher to a service resource, in the gap identified in the service resource’s schedule on a specific date. This action is one of the actions provided by the Agentforce: Field Service Actions feature.

To use Field Service topics and actions:.description: Access Agent Topics and Actions for Field Service

Required Setup.description: Set Up the Field Service Dispatcher Actions Topic
